debriefing.title: Thank you!
debriefing.text: Thank you again for participating in our study.

listblocks.text: All together, it will take about 5-8 minutes to finish this study.
Your child will watch short videos and answer questions by choosing pictures on the screen.
There are no right or wrong answers.

video-consent.risk_statement: There are no expected risks to participation.
video-consent.datause: A research assistant will watch your video and mark down your child's answers as well as other information such as interactions between you and your child during the study.
video-consent.payment: Please refer to the study listing for payment details.
video-consent.purpose: This study is about how children understand causal and psychological verbs.
video-consent.procedures: In this study your child will watch short scenarios and answer questions by selecting pictures on the screen.
video-consent.institution: The Markman Lab of Stanford University

parentTextBlock.text: Please help keep your child's attention, but don't tell them which answer to choose.
